insights.tam: Directional worldwide opportunity across compatibility, relationship questions, communication, and bonding terms. Exact volume is not available from the public sources used.
insights.opportunities: Build one interactive compatibility reflection page, then expand into question-led relationship-tip articles.
findings: Compatibility quiz intent is a strong bridge between the existing name-based calculator and deeper relationship content.
Long-tail questions about values, communication, and future goals are more winnable than broad relationship terms.
Public expert content favors reflection and practical conversation actions over deterministic compatibility claims.
A short quiz plus result-specific prompts creates more information gain than a static list of generic tips.
Google Trends is useful for comparing rising interest and locations, but it does not provide exact search counts.
recommendations: Publish compatibility-quiz.html as the next hub page and link it from the homepage and shared navigation.
Use five result areas: values, communication, conflict repair, time and affection, and shared direction.
Keep the quiz local and private in the browser. Do not collect names or relationship answers on a server.
Add five concise FAQ entries and FAQPage JSON-LD for direct-answer visibility.
Use the page as the internal-link hub for future articles on communication, relationship anxiety, and bonding routines.
